ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon (GhostEmperor/Earth Estries) LSASS credential dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
ucs.description: Hunts rundll32.exe invoking the comsvcs.dll MiniDump export (by name or ordinal #24) against lsass.exe — a signature Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries credential-access technique documented in Trend Micro's Earth Estries reporting and CISA's Salt Typhoon advisories on US telco intrusions. The actor prefers this LOLBin path over Mimikatz because comsvcs.dll is a signed Microsoft binary that bypasses naive AV signatures.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as process values(Processes.process_id) as process_id values(Processes.parent_process_name) as parent_process_name values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.process_name="rundll32.exe" (Processes.process="*comsvcs*MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs*#24*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,MiniDump*" OR Processes.process="*comsvcs.dll,#24*") by host Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.parent_process_name Processes.user Processes.process_id | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | search NOT user IN ("*$","SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE") | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Salt Typhoon LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump — Earth Estries / GhostEmperor signature TTP
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where FileName =~ "rundll32.exe"
| where ProcessCommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where ProcessCommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24", ", 24")
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| where AccountName !in~ ("system","local service","network service")
| project Timestamp, DeviceName, AccountName,
          ParentImage = InitiatingProcessFolderPath,
          ParentCmd   = InitiatingProcessCommandLine,
          ChildImage  = FolderPath,
          ChildCmd    = ProcessCommandLine,
          SHA256, ProcessIntegrityLevel
| order by Timestamp desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Salt Typhoon LSASS dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump on Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688 telemetry
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where NewProcessName endswith "\\rundll32.exe"
| where CommandLine has "comsvcs"
| where CommandLine has_any ("MiniDump", "#24", ", 24")
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| where SubjectUserName !in~ ("SYSTEM","LOCAL SERVICE","NETWORK SERVICE")
| project TimeGenerated, Computer, SubjectUserName, ParentProcessName, NewProcessName, CommandLine, TokenElevationType
| order by TimeGenerated desc
ucs.sigma_yaml:
title: Salt Typhoon LSASS Credential Dump via comsvcs.dll MiniDump
id: 7c4a8b22-a17c-4f1f-9d2b-3c1aa1a9e7b1
status: experimental
description: Detects rundll32 invoking the comsvcs.dll MiniDump export (by name or ordinal #24) — a signature Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries / GhostEmperor LSASS credential-access technique.
references:
  - https://www.trendmicro.com/en_us/research/24/k/earth-estries.html
  - https://www.cisa.gov/news-events/cybersecurity-advisories
author: SOC Detection Engineering
date: 2026/05/29
tags:
  - attack.credential_access
  - attack.t1003.001
  - attack.defense_evasion
  - attack.t1218.011
  - detection.threat_hunting
logsource:
  category: process_creation
  product: windows
detection:
  selection_img:
    Image|endswith: '\rundll32.exe'
  selection_cmd_named:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'comsvcs'
      - 'MiniDump'
  selection_cmd_ordinal:
    CommandLine|contains|all:
      - 'comsvcs'
      - '#24'
  condition: selection_img and 1 of selection_cmd_*
falsepositives:
  - Rare admin troubleshooting that dumps a process via comsvcs.dll directly
level: critical
ucs.datadog_query: source:(windows.sysmon OR windows.security) (@EventID:1 OR @EventID:4688) (@Image:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\Rundll32.exe) OR @NewProcessName:(*\rundll32.exe OR *\RUNDLL32.EXE OR *\Rundll32.exe)) (@CommandLine:(*comsvcs* AND (*MiniDump* OR *minidump* OR *MINIDUMP* OR *#24*)))
ucs.falcon_logscale_query:
#event_simpleName=ProcessRollup2 ImageFileName=/\\rundll32\.exe$/i
| regex("comsvcs", field=CommandLine)
| regex("(MiniDump|#24|, *24)", field=CommandLine)
| NOT UserName=/^(SYSTEM|LOCAL SERVICE|NETWORK SERVICE)$/i
| groupBy([aid, ComputerName, UserName, ParentBaseFileName, CommandLine, SHA256HashData], function=count())

ucs.title: [LLM] Salt Typhoon Exchange/IIS web shell — w3wp.exe spawning interactive shells from inetpub paths (SparrowDoor / China Chopper lineage)
ucs.description: Hunts the IIS worker process (w3wp.exe) spawning cmd/powershell/whoami/net/systeminfo/ipconfig from an Exchange or aspnet_client virtual-directory context — the post-exploitation pattern Earth Estries / FamousSparrow / Salt Typhoon used to drop SparrowDoor and China-Chopper-derivative ASPX web shells after exploiting public-facing Exchange / IIS servers (ProxyLogon, ProxyShell, and Cisco IOS XE pivots into management hosts). Catches initial-access → execution → discovery handoff on the same parent w3wp.
ucs.splunk: | tstats `security_content_summariesonly` count min(_time) as firstTime max(_time) as lastTime values(Processes.process) as cmdline values(Processes.process_id) as pid values(Processes.user) as user from datamodel=Endpoint.Processes where Processes.parent_process_name="w3wp.exe" Processes.process_name IN ("cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","hostname.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe") by host Processes.parent_process_name Processes.parent_process_id Processes.process_name Processes.process Processes.user | `drop_dm_object_name(Processes)` | stats min(firstTime) as firstTime max(lastTime) as lastTime values(process_name) as child_processes values(process) as child_cmds dc(process_name) as distinct_children by host parent_process_id user | where distinct_children >= 2 | `security_content_ctime(firstTime)` | `security_content_ctime(lastTime)`
ucs.kql:
// Salt Typhoon / Earth Estries / FamousSparrow — w3wp.exe spawning recon / shell binaries post-web-shell drop
let Recon = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","hostname.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
DeviceProcessEvents
| where Timestamp > ago(7d)
| where InitiatingProcessFileName =~ "w3wp.exe"
| where FileName in~ (Recon)
| where AccountName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(Timestamp), LastSeen = max(Timestamp),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(FileName),
            ChildList   = make_set(FileName, 20),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(ProcessCommandLine, 10),
            ParentCmd   = any(InitiatingProcessCommandLine),
            AppPoolUser = any(AccountName)
            by DeviceName, InitiatingProcessId, bin(Timestamp, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctChildren >= 2     // multiple recon children from same w3wp = handoff after web-shell drop, 2+ suppresses single-binary noise
| order by FirstSeen desc
ucs.sentinel_kql:
// Salt Typhoon Exchange/IIS web shell post-ex on Sentinel SecurityEvent 4688
let Recon = dynamic(["cmd.exe","powershell.exe","pwsh.exe","net.exe","net1.exe","whoami.exe","systeminfo.exe","ipconfig.exe","nltest.exe","tasklist.exe","quser.exe","hostname.exe","arp.exe","route.exe","reg.exe","sc.exe","schtasks.exe","wmic.exe","certutil.exe","bitsadmin.exe"]);
let WindowMinutes = 10m;
SecurityEvent
| where TimeGenerated > ago(7d)
| where EventID == 4688
| where ParentProcessName endswith "\\w3wp.exe"
| extend ChildBase = tolower(tostring(split(NewProcessName, "\\")[-1]))
| where ChildBase in (Recon)
| where SubjectUserName !endswith "$"
| summarize FirstSeen = min(TimeGenerated), LastSeen = max(TimeGenerated),
            DistinctChildren = dcount(ChildBase),
            ChildList   = make_set(ChildBase, 20),
            SampleCmds  = make_set(CommandLine, 10),
            ParentCmd   = any(ParentProcessName),
            AppPoolUser = any(SubjectUserName)
            by Computer, ProcessId, bin(TimeGenerated, WindowMinutes)
| where DistinctChildren >= 2
| order by FirstSeen desc
